usage.outputShape: body.data.items[0] contains: ip, country.{code,name}, region.{code,name}, city, postalCode, coords.{lat,lon}, timezone, network.{isp,org,asn}; body.meta.cost.usd confirms per-call charge
quirks: Registry records method as POST but endpoint only accepts GET — sending POST causes a 405 AFTER payment is deducted (non-refundable); always use GET
Response is double-nested: useful data is at body.data.items[0], not the top level
usage.guide: Call GET https://2s.io/api/geo/ip?ip=8.8.8.8 (or any IPv4/IPv6) via x402 on Base at $0.001 USDC per call. Include the ip as a query parameter in the URL — there is no request body. The geolocation payload is at body.data.items[0] with fields for country, region, city, postalCode, coords, timezone, and network/ISP info. Do not use POST despite what the registry entry says — POST returns 405 Method Not Allowed after payment is already taken.
